miniatlas_figshare_v3.corpus: The paper and README call the released model MiniAtlas-pretrained, but the inspected source and Figshare metadata do not provide an accession-level corpus roster, donor aliases, file-to-run receipt, or evidence excluding GSE289173 and its cohort family.

interpretation: The MiniAtlas checkpoint is ineligible because its accession-level exposure is unknown and it is not safely loadable under the project contract. A locally trained model avoids that contamination. Lower-level exact-source modules do provide a genuine frozen route from raw held RNA to a Bernoulli ATAC peak profile: RNA encoder, training-only latent scaling, source-replacement conditional DDPM, target latent unscaling, and ATAC sigmoid decoder. The released translation script is not an admissible implementation of that route because it reads both assays, fits query labels, hard-codes class state, and its DPM-Solver branches ignore source conditioning. GSE296875 is the only admitted same-nucleus training source; GSE244832 remains different-aliquot external development. GSE289173 can seal cell-state mapping only and remains target-label unexposed.
